# Which npm audit findings does your code actually use?

> Paste npm audit --json and your source imports: see which vulnerable packages your code actually imports, which are only reached through a dependency, and which are test-only noise. Free npm audit triage, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [How to triage npm audit findings without ignoring real risk](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/npm-audit-triage/how-to-triage-npm-audit-findings.html)
